messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning a fast v2 default flip tonight 01:30 UTC. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Post pins now if you need holdouts.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: id=deploy-17812, window=2025-03-03T01:30:00Z->2025-03-03T02:30:00Z, canary=5%, operator-rollforward. Confirm to start.

maya: SDK team: we shipped a patch to accept case-insensitive headers. Docs updated. Any tenants still on old SDKs?

ken: A few enterprise customers asked for 6h pin. I'll coordinate if they formally request.

priya: Rollback gates I want: 5xx > 1% sustained 3m OR p95 +200ms for 5m. Also abort if auth 401 >0.5% for 5m.

alex: Agreed. Keep v1 warm for 10m as fallback. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/v2-quickflip.

deploybot: canary started. posting health pings into thread.
deploybot: t+2m snapshot: 5xx=0.08%, p95 +10ms, auth 0.01%

ken: Looks clean. Ramp to 25% at discretion.

alex: Ramp to 25% now.

deploybot: ramped to 25%.
deploybot: t+8m snapshot: 5xx=0.6%, p95 +40ms, auth 0.02%

priya: All within thresholds. Proceed to 100% with 10m warm.

deploybot: default route switched to v2 at 2025-03-03T01:45:00Z. v1 warm for 10m.

maya: Release notes queued. No public rollback messaging unless we hit user-visible errors.

ken: Ops on watch for 10m. If anything spikes we'll run `deploybot rollback deploy-17812 --reason "telemetry"` and pin tenants as needed.

alex: Thanks team. Good deploy. :rocket:
